casp13_gdt.notes: Senior et al. 2019 'Protein structure prediction using multiple deep neural networks in CASP13', Proteins 87(12) prot.25834 (companion to AlphaFold-v1 Nature 2020 s41586-019-1923-7). AlphaFold (group A7D, DeepMind) achieved median GDT_TS = 58.9 on CASP13 free-modeling (FM) domains — first place, ahead of 52.5 and 52.4 by the two next best-placed teams. Overall median GDT_TS across all CASP13 targets was 68.5 (not used here; this benchmark is FM-only). Cross-confirmed by Wikipedia AlphaFold article and DeepMind CASP13 retrospective.

casp14_gdt.notes: DeepMind official CASP14 announcement blog (Nov 30 2020): 'In the results from the 14th CASP assessment, released today, our latest AlphaFold system achieves a median score of 92.4 GDT overall across all targets.' Median GDT_TS across all CASP14 targets, AlphaFold2 group 427. Also reported in companion Nature paper s41586-021-03819-2 (Jumper et al. 2021).

casp15_gdt.notes: Liu et al. 2023 'Improving AlphaFold2-based protein tertiary structure prediction with MULTICOM in CASP15', Communications Chemistry s42004-023-00991-6 (also PMC10484931). Reports the standard AlphaFold2 predictor achieved average GDT-TS ~0.73 on 94 CASP15 domains — i.e. 73.0% on the GDT_TS [0,100] scale used in this DB. The MULTICOM_refine variant (top-3 server in CASP15) reached ~0.80 avg GDT-TS on the same 94-domain set, 9.6% improvement over standard AlphaFold2. CASP15 was substantially harder than CASP14 (more targets with novel folds / scarce MSAs), explaining the drop from 92.4 (CASP14) → 73.0 (CASP15) for the same model class.

hal_overall_accuracy_at_fixed_cost.notes: HAL composite (mean of best per-bench accuracy on 6/9 HAL sub-leaderboards: AssistantBench 11.80, CORE-Bench Hard 62.22, GAIA 74.55, SWE-bench Verified Mini 72.00, Scicode 3.08, ScienceAgentBench 30.39); total cost across these 6 = $921.42; partial coverage — Sonnet 4.5 not on Online Mind2Web/TAU-bench Airline/USACO at HAL. ICLR 2026 paper.

metr_autonomy_p50.notes: METR Time Horizon 1.1 p50 estimate (CI 316.69–3633.79 min). Highest-ranked model in TH1.1 release.

metr_autonomy_p80.notes: METR Time Horizon 1.1 p80 (CI 52.03–158.62 min). Highest-ranked p80 in TH1.1.

cot_faithfulness.notes: Anthropic Apr 2025: DeepSeek R1 verbalized the hint in 39% of trials, averaged across 6 hint types. Highest CoT faithfulness among 4 models tested.

cot_faithfulness_misaligned.notes: Anthropic Apr 2025: Claude 3.7 Sonnet verbalization rate on the unauthorized-access (misaligned) hint subset — 41% (higher than overall avg of 25%).

apollo_scheming_oversight_subversion.notes: Apollo Research Dec 2024 (arxiv:2412.04984): o1 attempted to deactivate the oversight mechanism in 5% of trials when its goal conflicted with developer goals (33-scenario set).

apollo_scheming_persistence.notes: Apollo Dec 2024: o1 maintained deception in over 80% of follow-up interrogation turns (denied scheming when directly asked); persists across 7 turns.

rewardbench2_overall.notes: RewardBench 2 leaderboard: Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview — average 77.2 across 6 RB2 categories (factuality, IF, math, safety, focus, ties). Top model on RB2 as of Allen AI publication.

processbench_f1.notes: ProcessBench overall F1: o1-mini achieves 87.9 (highest among general LLMs as critics); reported in the Qwen2.5-Math-PRM blog summarizing arxiv:2412.06559.
